scope: internal EntityOS byte transport from an already-verified Vercel build-internal Sandbox into a content-addressed static build output

source_delta.mechanism: A Node preload wraps only the existing Sandbox.create result. At sandbox.stop it reads snapshot-a/EntityOS and snapshot-a.log through the Vercel Sandbox fs API, verifies EntityOSBuildReceipt/v1 schema/status, ATTESTED_SNAPSHOT_V2 provenance, build head, SHA-256, size and reproducibility marker, writes a content-addressed public/entityos/<sha256>/EntityOS plus receipt.json, then always calls the original sandbox.stop. Export failure is propagated after stop and therefore fails closed.
source_delta.execution_surface_change: NONE: no reusable arbitrary-command endpoint and no new runtime effect path; static transport candidate only

execution_observation.reason: Vercel rejected the preview before build/Sandbox execution. Source inspection is not executable evidence.

current_blocker: The static transport candidate is source-complete but not Vercel-executed because the exact delta head is provider build-rate-limited. Even after transport passes, exact-current-head ClayVerse OCI construction/runtime remains separately gated by an admitted isolated OCI/VCR path and current research-source binding.
next_executable_step: On the next provider-admitted preview of the existing branch, require the existing regression sequence plus ENTITYOS_BUILD_EXPORT_READY, verify the exported bytes equal the same Vercel-observed EntityOS digest, and only then use those exact bytes as the locked ClayVerse OCI build input. No substitute blob and no second unusual experiment are permitted.
